I will not put chemical fertilizer on this beans plot because it is small, and for beans I usually rely on the soil and what little I have at home. I will plant my local seed, work it with my family, and keep it rainfed since we depend on the rains here. I do not expect to buy pesticide or hire many people for such a small piece of land.
